==Description==
'''Abandoned City''', internally referred to as '''Abandoned City_SM''', is an altered version of [[Abandoned City]] made for [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. Unlike its regular version, certain buildings were removed to make the map easier.

==Design & Path==
'''Abandoned City''' takes place in an urbanized city, which was abandoned. Half the city is covered in water, with only the roofs of the flooded buildings can be seen. Multiple cars can also be seen near a slope which lead into the lower part of the city before the flood, which were most likely used to escape the flood and then abandoned. The city itself is surrounded by hills. The city comprises residential buildings ranging from one floor to three floors. Some buildings have air vents on the roof or power boxes on the walls. Multiple buildings can be found in the city with cars sometimes parked next to them. The city is pedestrianized, with a few trash cans, dumpsters, recycle bins and benches being present on the pavement. Despite multiple cars being present on the map, there is only one road that leads to the flooded part of the city. A few parts of the city also have trees and bushes growing on them.

The path stars and ends at a pedestrian tunnel. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding buildings present on the map.

The main difference between this and the regular [[Abandoned City]] is that three buildings, that one building inside the first u-turn, second u-turn and third u-turn are removed.

==Strategy==
*You should place your towers near the middle of the map, as the path has a good amount of turns there.
*Short-range towers, such as the [[Brawler]], [[Shotgunner]] and [[Sledger]], do well on this map due to its many bends and corners.
*Be aware of the limited ground space on this map as the buildings are quite close together.
**This may reduce the effectiveness of the [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] towards ground towers.
*This map has plenty of cliff spots, making both the [[Ranger]] and [[Mortar]] very useful in this map.
**Due to the map design, cliff towers can cover most if not all of the path in this map, making them especially valuable.
